Preserve80-byte ACK/signature, use explicit production initialTTL12 and scoped per-hop decrement. Do not require MESSAGE RELAY_OK on canonical ACK flags0. Local ATT offer never retires ACK custody.

specification.Important pseudocode where useful: Apply the detailed algorithm in section 14. specification.Concurrency/lifecycle implications: Exercise retries, duplicate completion, timeout, stop/start and process interruption at the affected boundary. For pure build tasks, serialize artifact promotion and state-file writes.
